## Problem
A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve.

## Proposed solution
What you want to happen.

## Frozen-core note
Changes to `simulator/`, `gateway/`, `backend/`, `frontend/`, or
`requirements.txt` are restricted by the frozen-core policy in
CONTRIBUTING.md. Describe how your feature fits the release layer
(`scripts/`, `docs/`, `Dockerfile`, CI, GitHub templates) or justify why a
core change is required.

## Alternatives considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
